abstract: Maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and total beta-human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) concentrations were measured at the 15th gestational week in ten pregnancies complicated by fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma. The findings corresponded to those in normal pregnancies. Similarly, third-trimester concentrations of cancer antigen 12-5, tumour-associated trypsin inhibitor, and the amino-terminal propeptide of type III procollagen in the maternal serum were not significantly elevated. Histologically mature and immature/malignant cases did not differ from each other as regards the above-mentioned parameters. This abnormality cannot be detected by maternal serum trisomy screening in the second trimester.
abstract_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫を合併した10例の妊娠について、妊娠15週に母体血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)および総ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)濃度を測定した。その所見は正常妊娠と一致した。同様に、妊娠後期の母体血清におけるCA 12-5、腫瘍関連トリプシンインヒビター、III型プロコラーゲンのアミノ末端プロペプチドの濃度も有意な上昇を示さなかった。組織学的に成熟型の症例と未熟型・悪性型の症例の間で、上記の指標に差は認められなかった。この異常は第2三半期の母体血清トリソミースクリーニングでは検出できない。
